evidence: Bat Trang Pottery Village, situated on the outskirts of Hanoi, Vietnam, is renowned for its exquisite ceramics and porcelain, which have been crafted there since the 14th century during the Ly-Tran dynasty. The village's location in an area abundant with clay suitable for ceramic production has contributed significantly to its historical prominence as one of the premier centers for pottery in Vietnam, alongside other notable villages such as Chu Đậu, Biên Hòa, Phù Lãng, Hương Canh, Lái Thiêu, and Bầu Trúc.
